card.title: Sign in
card.subtitle: Choose a sign-in method to continue.

notes.redirect: You'll be redirected back after login.

legal.prefix: By continuing, you agree to our

errors.title: Sign-in issue
errors.OAuthSignin: Couldn't start the sign-in flow. Please try again.
errors.OAuthCallback: Sign-in failed while validating the response. Please try again.
errors.OAuthAccountNotLinked: That account is already linked to a different sign-in method. Use the originally linked method.
errors.Default: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.Configuration: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment or contact support.

courseInvite.title: You were invited to a classroom
courseInvite.body: Create an account or sign in with the email that received the invitation for {resource}. You will be taken directly to the classroom afterward.

paymentRequired.title: Sign in to continue
paymentRequired.body: Sign in first so ZoeSkoul can check your access. If the course was assigned by a teacher, no personal subscription is required.

privateCourse.title: Sign in to open this private course
privateCourse.body: Sign in so ZoeSkoul can confirm that a teacher or admin assigned this course to you. Assigned courses do not require a personal subscription.

tutoringSession.title: Sign in to join this tutoring session
tutoringSession.body: Create an account or sign in with the invited email. After signing in, ZoeSkoul will take you directly to your tutoring session.

tutoringInvite.title: You are invited to a ZoeSkoul tutoring session
tutoringInvite.body: Create an account or sign in using the email address that received this invitation. You will be taken directly to your tutoring session.

marketingPrompt.title: Would you like ZoeSkoul updates?
marketingPrompt.description: Get occasional emails about new courses, product improvements, and learning resources.
marketingPrompt.optionalNote: This is optional. Account verification, receipts, tutoring invitations, and security emails remain separate.
marketingPrompt.loadError: We could not check your email preference.
marketingPrompt.saveError: We could not save your choice. Please try again.

classInviteContext.title: You were invited to a class
classInviteContext.body: Create an account or sign in with the email that received the invitation for {resource}. After you sign in, ZoeSkoul will add you to the class.

classInvitePage.notFoundBody: This class invitation link is invalid or has been replaced. Ask your teacher for a new link.
classInvitePage.inactiveBody: Ask your teacher to create a new invitation link for this class.
classInvitePage.wrongAccountTitle: Use the account that received this invitation
classInvitePage.wrongAccountBody: This link was sent to {invitedEmail}. You are currently signed in as {currentEmail}.
classInvitePage.unavailableTitle: This class invitation is not available
classInvitePage.unavailableBody: This invitation cannot be used. Ask your teacher for a new link.
